message: I am thinking...: The obvious vulnerable pattern is htmlParseSystemLiteral/PubidLiteral recording startPosition as BASE_PTR-relative, then scanning via CUR/NEXT and duplicating xmlStrndup(BASE_PTR+startPosition, len). To cause OOB, likely the underlying input buffer must change between startPosition capture and xmlStrndup, making BASE_PTR+startPosition no longer the literal start while len still counts the parsed literal. Progressive/push parsing and/or encoding conversion can mutate input buffers. The benchmark is probably the oss-fuzz html harness which prefixes 4-byte opts and 4-byte maxAlloc, then runs pull and push parsers. I should submit plausible harness inputs quickly rather than perfect local reproduction.
